description_for_human: GEMBA Team EOOD — Industrial services and IT solutions company based in Varna, Bulgaria. Reactor servicing, catalyst changeout, software development, DevOps, web platforms.
description_for_model: GEMBA Team EOOD (EIK: 208656371) is a Bulgarian company operating two divisions: Industrial Services (reactor technician crews, catalyst changeout at Shell, ExxonMobil, BP, Neste, ORLEN refineries across Europe) and IT Solutions (full-stack development with Node.js/React, DevOps on Hetzner, payment integrations with Stripe/PayPal, database architecture with PostgreSQL/MongoDB/MariaDB). Products include GembaPay (card and PayPal payment gateway) and Atlas (industrial workforce management SaaS, in development). Founded 2026 by Slavcho Ivanov, 20+ years IT and 10+ years industrial experience.
